notes.title: Police Chase Mode is available now!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hey everyone![/b]
A brand-new update is live — and with it comes an exciting new game mode![/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience. We know this one took a bit longer than expected, and we truly appreciate you sticking with us.[/p][p]Cosette has been chasing our beloved characters for a long time... but have you ever wondered what it's like to see things from [i]her[/i] point of view?[/p][p][b]The chase begins now. Let’s see what you’ve got.[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1][b]Accessing the New Game Mode: Police Chase[/b][/h1][p]
To unlock this mode, you’ll need to [b]purchase the character Cosette[/b] in the in-game shop.[/p][p]In Police Chase mode, you can only play as Cosette — she’s not available in any other game mode.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/d34a0a60babd88d7733b5a3b66abebff52b1deb0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Objective:[/b] Catch your target before they reach [b]Bounce City![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]To stop them, you’ll need to land a [b]Perfect Dodge[/b] or perform a [b]Traffic Check[/b]. Here’s a quick breakdown of how each one works:[/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Perfect Dodge[/u][/b][/h2][p]
Dodge an obstacle at the very last moment before getting hit.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/3e608ec1ac40114bab3682d394c952e73b539f30.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Traffic Check[/u][/b][/h2][p]
Build up a x4 multiplier by dodging consecutively (x2 → x3 → x4). Once you hit x4, you can smash through glowing obstacles to earn extra points and extend your time![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/cdf06225700ba4562e2e44846bbea5191e9075da.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Gold Medal Reward[/u][/b][/h2][p]
Earn a Gold Medal (Score: 1,000,000) in Police Chase mode to unlock a brand-new scene in the Gallery.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/2a9c110813dc79ce87ec471562902751ee93b4f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1][b]The official [i]Riding to Bounce City[/i] soundtrack is now available.[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Heed the melodies of Bounce City — the official soundtrack is here.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3769640/Riding_to_Bounce_City_Soundtrack/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1]Join Our Community[/h1][p]Your feedback helps shape the future of our game! Join our [url="https://discord.gg/RYHC52bywH"]Official Discord server![/url] and share your thoughts with us. Thank you for your patience and support.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][u]Riding to Bounce City ver-1.6.5c / Patch notes[/u][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Languages: Czech, Dutch, German, Polish, Russian, Thai, Turkish, and Ukrainian[/p][/*][*][p]Police Chase Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Character Introduction: Cosette now has a video introduction[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Scene[/b]: Available in the Gallery (requires a Gold Medal in Police Chase mode)[/p][/*][*][p]UI Improvement: The interface in the gallery now hides automatically when no buttons are pressed[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Main Menu: New background music added[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Riding to Bounce City ver 1.5.2c
notes.content:
[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

Fixes & Updates:

[list]
[*] [h2]Fireworks Resolution in Snowy Street[/h2]

Improved the resolution of the fireworks effect in the "Snowy Street" stage. Previously, the resolution was lowered for compression purposes, resulting in blurry visuals. This has been restored to ensure clear and sharp explosions.

[*] [h2]Camera and Clothes Switching Issue (Zara)[/h2]

Fixed a bug where changing between "Camera 5" and the "Special Camera" would incorrectly display the wrong "Clothes" selection.

[*] [h2]Zara Added to Adventure Mode (Random)[/h2]

Zara is now fully integrated into Adventure Mode (Random).

Resolved an issue where selecting Zara before starting this mode caused an error that prevented the player from controlling the character.

[*] [h2]General Clothes Fixes for Zara[/h2]

Addressed various issues affecting Zara's "Clothes," ensuring consistent behavior and appearance across all game modes.

[*] [h2]Gifts System Adjustments[/h2]

Fixed a bug in Hard difficulty where "Gifts" were not spawning double the "Cameras" and "Clothes" as intended.

Sprites for "Gifts" have been improved
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support!
Enjoy the update, and as always, share your feedback to help us improve further!

notes.title: Enter the Chaos in the Cosmos of Bounce City

[h1]New Character: Haley[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/35013f368ef76eb885d21393b1bab64c7cd029b8.png[/img]
She's a portal-traveling sensation, but this time, something mysterious has gone wrong. The portal now behaves unpredictably, causing the creation of the enigmatic 'Chaos in the Cosmos' stage. Join Haley on her journey and unravel the cosmic mysteries.


[h1]New Stage: Chaos in the Cosmos[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/2f71bdf2d98e20cd88f9892d292110bf481a8fd4.png[/img]
Prepare for an extraordinary adventure as you enter the 'Chaos in the Cosmos' stage. This new battleground features a mind-bending twist - it randomly transitions between previous stages, making each playthrough a unique and challenging experience.


[h1]Zombies Unleashed[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/976ecc8182b1c22d49e38773d36a59527c95097f.png[/img]
But that's not all! Brace yourself for a frightful surprise - zombies have invaded the cosmos! The 'Chaos in the Cosmos' stage is now crawling with these undead fiends. Will you have what it takes to survive the cosmic zombie apocalypse?

notes.title: Unlock a World of Adventure: The Game Update You've Been Waiting For

[h2]New Characters: [/h2]
Meet our two fantastic new characters, Mandy, the streamer, and Kate, the teacher.

Start your journey with a bang! Both Mandy and Kate now have brand-new introductions that will get you even more... excited to play.

notes.title: Something Wicked is coming to Bounce City...
notes.content:
[h1]Halloween Special[/h1]
A spooktacular theme has arrived with the classic Halloween elements you know and love.


[h1]New Map: Castle[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/b3c3e9a0e33b3d5fa0a07ca864385e582069afff.png[/img]
There is something strange happening inside this long-abandoned castle: the lights come off, there are ghosts, tentacles, and pumpkins; and at midnight it sounds a bell that changes the surroundings. What else could be waiting inside?


[h1]New Character: Roxanne[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/1dbc886babdd5bd55de6d7b3c332dae7161bbdc5.png[/img]
This beloved witch decided to reveal herself and ride to Bounce City, along with some "tricks or treats" to help the other girls.


[h1]New Equipment Items[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941872/948e7bfd563398bd61fd7b8cd708f71b4b7ed550.png[/img]
These "tricks or treats" are Special Witch Hats of Roxanne, and can be equipped until certain conditions are met, like reaching day 2 or 3 on some specific map.
The Special Hats will help you unlock faster the characters, decorations, cameras, and clothes. (you can only equip one at a time)




[i]Be afraid! This event starts from October 20 to November 4.[/i] [spoiler](Roxanne and the Castle are here to stay, permanently)[/spoiler]
